items.question: Which chapter number and topic conclude this section of the Aṃśumān-Kāśyapa scripture?
premises: The colophon marks the text as the Aṃśumān-Kāśyapa.
The chapter is titled as concerning the arrangement of four floors.
The chapter is identified as the twenty-ninth.
items.inference: This verse is a colophon stating that the twenty-ninth chapter, on the arrangement of four floors, concludes in the Aṃśumān-Kāśyapa.
uncertainties: The precise internal analysis of the fused compound ityaṃśumānkāśyape follows conventional colophon usage.
items.plain_english: Thus ends the twenty-ninth chapter, on the arrangement of four floors, in the Aṃśumān-Kāśyapa.
